answer: Superlinear slashing matrices bind staking collateral C to a penalty function P(C)=k*C^alpha with alpha>1, so any deviating agent faces expected loss L=P(C)-R*C where reward R<k*C^(alpha-1), guaranteeing negative utility. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay enforces immutable finality, preventing front-running and fixing the strategy space, thus the game reaches a subgame-perfect Nash equilibrium where the ledge of capital forms a glacier of slashes converging at the vertex of rational abstention.
